en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a large town hall building with a central clock tower and tall spire, facing an open cobblestone square. The multi‑storey facade has arched entrances with staircases, rows of windows decorated with flower boxes, and an adjoining building marked 'Klosterkeller'. Small figures and a cart are visible in the square. Printed captions at the top read 'Rosswein.' and 'Rathaus und Klosterkeller.'
